presets.name: Puppies
presets.summary: Big glossy eyes on the compact sitting build.
presets.description: The puppy eyes are one of eleven eye sets, and the sitting body is the smallest of the three builds. Together they make every dog look a few months old.

presets.name: Big Dogs
presets.summary: The tall build with the small head and long legs.
presets.description: The Great Dane build: a smaller head on a deep chest, the shoulders right under the chin. The head family still varies, so a tall poodle and a tall husky both turn up.

presets.name: Stocky
presets.summary: A big head low in wide shoulders.
presets.description: The bulldog build, short legs set wide. Pairs well with the flat-faced heads but is not limited to them.

presets.name: Floppy Ears
presets.summary: Beagle, basset and poodle heads only.
presets.description: Three of the nine head families let the ears hang: the labrador and beagle head, the basset and cocker head with ears down to the shoulders, and the scalloped poodle head.

presets.name: Pointed Ears
presets.summary: Shepherd, spitz and french bulldog heads only.
presets.description: The three families whose ears stand up: the shepherd and husky head, the pomeranian head with its ruff, and the wide head with the tall bat ears.

presets.name: Flat Faces
presets.summary: Pug, bulldog and french bulldog heads only.
presets.description: The short-muzzled families. The pug carries a dark muzzle instead of markings, and the bulldog has jowls that hang past the mouth.

presets.name: Bandanas
presets.description: One of the four collar variants, on every dog instead of a share of them. The bandana takes the collar color, so the shipped red, blue, green and gold still spread across a set.

presets.name: Bare Neck
presets.description: Six in ten dogs wear a collar by default. Turning it off leaves the chest patch as the only thing between the head and the paws.

presets.name: Indoors
presets.summary: Living room, bedroom or nursery behind the dog.
presets.description: Three of the six scenes are rooms. Keeping to those gives a set one kind of place and a narrower band of wall colors.

presets.name: Outdoors
presets.summary: Meadow, forest or playground behind the dog.
presets.description: The other half of the scenes, all under a sky. The greens and blues sit further from the fur colors than the room walls do.

presets.name: Studio
presets.summary: No scene, a flat pale ground instead.
presets.description: The scene is what paints the tile, and without it the dog sits on nothing. A background color fills that in. Use this when the avatars have to sit on one flat color across a whole interface.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: Grey fur on a grey ground, scene off.
presets.description: The scenes carry their own colors and no option reaches them, so a monochrome set has to drop the scene first. Fur, tongue, blush and collar all move to grey.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The animation is off by default and `animation: true` switches it on, so the head tilts and the tail wags. `tiltAnimation: true` or `wagAnimation: true` plays just one of the two, and `animationSpeed` sets the pace. The motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
